objects.name: base
objects.prompt: A pixel art question mark icon in a retro 16-bit video game style, featuring a bold and clearly recognizable question mark symbol. Use a harmonious color palette of emerald green, white, and soft pink. The question mark should have a cute, polished, colorful, and playful design, with crisp pixelated edges, chunky pixel clusters, subtle pixel-based highlights and shadows, and strong visual clarity. No smooth gradients, no anti-aliasing, centered composition, isolated on a transparent or simple solid background. Charming, polished gaming aesthetic, high-quality pixel art.
